refnamediv.refpurpose: Save the mission to an external file

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: SaveMission exports the configured host mission to a script file. It saves the host resources and main mission sequence, including when the command is called from a GMAT function. It does not capture function-local resources, the current function body, or an execution checkpoint.

The default ExecutionPolicy = LegacyTerminal preserves the original behavior: export only when SaveMission is the final main-sequence command, allowing trailing Script Event closing markers. Commands inside functions or before another main-sequence command do not export under this policy.

Select ExecutionPolicy = Immediate to export whenever the command executes, including inside functions, loops and branches. Repeated executions overwrite the selected destination. The policy can be selected in the command editor after adding default options.

Filename is required. Enclose it in single quotes and double an embedded apostrophe. A bare filename uses the configured OUTPUT_PATH; filenames containing a directory use that path. If no extension is supplied, .script is appended. Serialization, open, write and close failures stop the command with an error.
